description: a duel on the Acid island's pools

1.name: Kindle
1.description: Sets the target alight: 6 damage and one more burn.

10.name: Tempest
10.description: 10 damage in a wide area, then a storm that strikes every enemy inside for 3 turns. 75% more through your pylon.

11.name: Hydro Cannon
11.description: A huge jet of water: 12 damage, throws the target 3 cells back, and leaves water where it stood.

12.name: Bubble Trap
12.description: Sets bubbles on the free cells of a cross. The first enemy to step on one takes 10 damage and cannot move again this turn.

13.name: Downpour
13.description: 3 damage and a wide area of water for good: enemies starting a turn in it lose 1 MP, you heal 5.

14.name: Frozen Ground
14.description: 10 damage and a cross of ice for good: whoever steps on it slides to the far side.

15.name: Maelstrom
15.description: 12 damage in a cross, strips every buff, and holds the enemies in place for a turn. For 3 turns it drags them back to its centre.

16.name: Earthleap
16.description: Leap onto a free cell up to 5 away. The landing does 4 damage to everyone next to it.

17.name: Hammer
17.description: 12 damage to a target next to you, and 2 MP off its next turn so it cannot get away.

18.name: Stone Grapple
18.description: 6 damage and drags the target 2 cells towards you.

19.name: Pillar
19.description: Raises a cairn of five floating stones on a free cell. Nothing walks through it or sees past it. While you stand in the square of eight cells around it, it takes the blows aimed at you, a stone for every 3, until it has soaked up 15 and crumbles.

2.name: Scorched Earth
2.description: 5 damage and a wall of fire five cells wide, straight across the cast, that stays for good. Anyone who walks in, or starts a turn there, catches a burn.

20.name: Earthquake
20.description: 14 damage to every enemy within 2 cells and 2 MP off their next turn. Opens fissures around you for good.

21.name: Lantern Swing
21.description: 7 damage to a target next to you, and the cell it stands on catches fire for 2 turns: the caged heart comes down and bursts.

22.name: Heart Burst
22.description: Up to 5 cells away, even on an empty cell: 3 damage in a cross, and the cross burns for a turn. The heart swells and spits it out.

23.name: Lance Charge
23.description: The lance runs through three cells in a line from the one next to you: 6 damage to everyone on it, thrown a cell back. From your pylon, 75% harder.

24.name: Steel Feathers
24.description: Three feathers up to 6 cells away, 2 damage each, and each can strike critically. From your pylon, 75% harder.

25.name: Trident Hook
25.description: Up to 2 cells away: 6 damage, and the prongs drag the target a cell towards you.

26.name: Tide Orb
26.description: Up to 5 cells away: 4 damage, and a puddle where it bursts for 2 turns. Your water slows enemies and heals you.

27.name: Flail Sweep
27.description: The flail swings all the way round: 6 damage to everyone on the four cells next to you.

28.name: Stone Lob
28.description: Up to 4 cells away, over anything in between: 5 damage from a stone lobbed high.

29.name: King's Cleaver
29.description: The Ashen King appears and brings his greatsword down on a line of three cells: 16 damage. What else it does depends on the element you wear.

Air.description: Judgement of Lightning: everyone on the line is thrown 2 cells back, and the blade stays planted where it fell as your pylon.

Earth.description: The ground splits: a menhir rises on each side of where the blade fell, and everyone on the line loses 2 MP next turn.

Fire.description: The line catches fire for good, and everyone on it takes 2 burns.

Water.description: A blade of water: everyone on the line is thrown 2 cells back, and the line turns to ice for good.

3.name: Combustion
3.description: Makes the target's burns go off at once: 6 damage, plus everything they had left to burn.

30.name: Three-Headed Ray
30.description: Aurorion appears and its three heads fire at one cell anywhere within 8: three rays of 6 damage, each with its own chance to crit. What else they do depends on the element you wear.

Air.description: Every ray throws its target a cell back, and running into something hurts each time.

Earth.description: A crystal prison: rocks rise on every side of the target but yours, for two of your turns.

Fire.description: Every ray sets its target alight: three burns, as many as a fighter can carry.

Water.description: The rays freeze a cross of cells for good, and hold the target where it stands for a turn.

31.name: Thunder Drums
31.description: Fulgor appears and beats his drums on a cell within 7: 8 damage now, 8 more at the start of your next turn and 14 at the one after, to whoever stands there. What else each beat does depends on the element you wear.

Air.description: The beats follow whoever the first one struck, wherever they go, a little softer: 6, 6 and 10.

Earth.description: Every beat takes a movement point off the next turn, and the last splits the ground open around the cell.

Fire.description: Every beat sets a burn, and the last sets them all off at once.

Water.description: The drums flood a cross of cells for good, and lightning through water hits 50% harder.

32.name: Maw of the Deep
32.description: Sahr'Khan carries you under the sand to a free cell within 6. You burst out: 14 damage to everyone next to you, thrown 2 cells away. What else it does depends on the element you wear.

Air.description: A storm of spice: smoke round where you come out for two of your turns, nothing seen through it.

Earth.description: The worm stays around you: a shield that soaks 10 from every hit until your next turn.

Fire.description: The sand around you catches fire for good, and everyone you burst out beside takes a burn.

Water.description: Quicksand: water round where you come out, for good, and everyone you burst out beside is held for a turn.

4.name: Smokescreen
4.description: Fills a cross of cells with smoke that nothing can be seen through, for good.

5.name: Meteor
5.description: Anywhere on the board: 22 damage and two burns in a wide blast that throws everyone out of it. Digs a crater and leaves the ground around it on fire.

6.name: Updraft
6.description: Raises your copper pylon on a free cell. Your air spells and your basic attack go out from it whenever it reaches, 75% harder. It blocks the way and hides what is behind it; 12 health, and it goes off when it breaks.

7.name: Lightning
7.description: 7 damage and 1 MP off the target’s next turn. 50% more on a target standing in water, and 75% more through your pylon.

8.name: Gale
8.description: 5 damage and throws the target 3 cells back; running into something hurts. Through your pylon it draws the target in instead, 75% harder, and slams it into the pylon.

9.name: Transfer
9.description: Aim at your pylon, wherever it stands: you and it change places.
